requestBody.description:

`pubkeys` is **optional**. When omitted, rewards are returned for all validators belonging to the tenant. When provided, only rewards for the specified validators (up to 100) are returned. post.description: Submit a signed RLP-encoded EIP-1559 transaction to the Ethereum network.

requestBody.description:
Submit a signed EIP-1559 transaction to the Ethereum network.

To cancel a pending transaction: craft a new transaction with the same nonce and a higher gas price, sign it, and broadcast it.

To resubmit (speed up) a pending transaction: same approach — same nonce, higher gas.

post.description:
Build unsigned consolidation transactions to merge validators (EIP-7251).

Source and target validators must share the same withdrawal credentials.

**Signing:** Must be signed by withdrawal address (`signer: WITHDRAWAL_ADDRESS`).

**Verification:** Before signing, verify:
- `inputs` matches your request
- `unsigned_transaction.to` equals the consolidation precompile
- `unsigned_transaction.from` is your withdrawal address

404.description: Source or target validator not found

422.description: Incompatible withdrawal credentials, or source and target validator are the same without eligible credentials to switch to compounding

error.message: Source and target validators must share withdrawal credentials

requestBody.description:
Request to create unsigned consolidation transactions (EIP-7251).

Merges source validator into target. Both must share withdrawal credentials.

post.description:
Build unsigned top-up transactions to add ETH to validator balances.

**Signing:** Anyone can fund a top-up (`signer: ANY`).

**Verification:** Before signing, verify:
- `inputs` matches your request
- `unsigned_transaction.to` equals the deposit contract
- `unsigned_transaction.value` matches expected amount

requestBody.description: Request to create unsigned top-up transactions.

post.description:
Build unsigned EL withdrawal transactions (partial or full).

Use `amount_gwei: 0` for full withdrawal (max available).

**Signing:** Must be signed by withdrawal address (`signer: WITHDRAWAL_ADDRESS`).

**Verification:** Before signing, verify:
- `inputs` matches your request
- `unsigned_transaction.to` equals the withdrawal precompile
- `unsigned_transaction.from` is your withdrawal address

requestBody.description:
Request to create unsigned withdrawal transactions.

Use `amount_gwei: "0"` for full withdrawal.

get.description: Query the current on-chain status of a transaction by hash.
Retrieve a paginated list of validators with optional filters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Filter by validator status.

 - PROVISIONED: Provisioned by node operator, awaiting deposit.
 - PENDING_DEPOSIT: Deposit submitted, awaiting beacon chain recognition.
 - PENDING_ACTIVATION: Recognized on beacon chain, awaiting activation queue.
 - ACTIVE: Active and attesting.
 - EXITING: Exit initiated, in exit queue.
 - EXITED: Exited but funds not yet withdrawn.
 - WITHDRAWN: Funds withdrawn to withdrawal address.
 - SLASHED: Slashed validator.

parameters.name: pubkeys
parameters.description: Filter by validator public keys (96 hex chars with 0x prefix each).

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100, max: 250).

get.description: Retrieve all registered webhook endpoints for the tenant. Secrets are never returned.

post.description:
Register a new webhook endpoint to receive push notifications when operations reach a terminal status.

When an operation completes (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or PARTIAL_SUCCESS), the system POSTs a signed JSON payload to each registered endpoint.

**Signature verification:** Each request includes `X-Staking-Router-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<hmac>` where the HMAC is `HMAC-SHA256(secret, "{timestamp}.{body}")`. Check that `t` is within ±5 minutes to guard against replay attacks.

error.message: url must be a valid HTTPS endpoint

requestBody.description: RegisterWebhookRequest registers a new webhook endpoint.

delete.description: Remove a registered webhook endpoint. In-flight deliveries are not cancelled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook endpoint ID to delete.

post.description: Submit a client-signed Solana transaction to the network and return the transaction signature.
Build an unsigned transaction to delegate a stake account to a validator vote account.

requestBody.description: Request to create an unsigned delegation transaction.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction to merge a source stake account into a destination stake account.

requestBody.description:
Request to create an unsigned merge transaction.

Both accounts must share the same stake and withdraw authorities and be in compatible states.
The source account is closed after merge; its balance is added to the destination.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction to rotate the durable nonce value. Use this to invalidate previously crafted transactions without submitting them.

requestBody.description:
Request to advance a durable nonce account.

Rotates the stored nonce value, invalidating any previously crafted transactions that used the old nonce.
Use this to invalidate a transaction without submitting it (e.g. after a signing failure).

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction that creates and initializes a durable nonce account. The derived nonce account address is returned in the response.

requestBody.description:
Request to create and initialize a durable nonce account.

The nonce account is funded by funding_pubkey and initialized with nonce_authority_pubkey as authority.
Keep the account funded above the rent-exempt minimum (1_447_680 lamports) to avoid data loss.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction to withdraw lamports from a durable nonce account. Withdrawing the full balance closes the account.

requestBody.description:
Withdraws lamports from a durable nonce account (WithdrawNonceAccount).

Accepts any positive amount_lamports and transfers that amount to the recipient.
The nonce account is closed (invalidating all previously crafted transactions that used its nonce value) only when amount_lamports equals the full account balance; partial withdrawals leave the account open and the nonce valid.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction to split a portion of a stake account into a new stake account.

requestBody.description:
Request to create an unsigned stake split transaction.

Creates a new stake account with the specified amount split from the source.
The new account address is derived via CreateAccountWithSeed.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction that creates and initializes a native Solana stake account.

requestBody.description:
Request to create an unsigned stake account creation transaction.

The stake account address is derived via CreateAccountWithSeed from the funding pubkey.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction to transfer SOL between accounts.

requestBody.description: Request to create an unsigned SOL transfer transaction.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction to deactivate (undelegate) a stake account.

requestBody.description:
Request to create an unsigned deactivation (undelegate) transaction.

After deactivation the stake becomes withdrawable at the end of the current epoch.

post.description: Build an unsigned transaction to withdraw SOL from a deactivated stake account.

requestBody.description:
Request to create an unsigned withdrawal transaction.

The stake account must be fully deactivated (cooling-down epoch elapsed).
`amount_lamports` must be greater than 0.

balance_gwei.description: Current balance in Gwei. uint64 supports ~18 billion ETH (~150x total supply).

effective_balance_gwei.description: Effective balance in Gwei. uint64 supports ~18 billion ETH (~150x total supply).

presigned_exit_available.description: Whether a pre-signed exit message is available.

ValidatorDetail.description: ValidatorDetail represents an Ethereum validator (detail view).

ValidatorExitStatus.description: ValidatorExitStatus contains the exit status for a single validator.

ValidatorFeeRecipientStatus.description: ValidatorFeeRecipientStatus contains the fee recipient update status.

ValidatorStatus.description:
ValidatorStatus defines the lifecycle state of a validator.

 - PROVISIONED: Provisioned by node operator, awaiting deposit.
 - PENDING_DEPOSIT: Deposit submitted, awaiting beacon chain recognition.
 - PENDING_ACTIVATION: Recognized on beacon chain, awaiting activation queue.
 - ACTIVE: Active and attesting.
 - EXITING: Exit initiated, in exit queue.
 - EXITED: Exited but funds not yet withdrawn.
 - WITHDRAWN: Funds withdrawn to withdrawal address.
 - SLASHED: Slashed validator.

amount_gwei.description: Amount to withdraw in Gwei. 0 = full withdrawal. uint64 supports ~18 billion ETH (~150x total supply).

withdrawal_address.description:

If omitted, the unsigned transaction will have empty from and signers fields.

WithdrawInput.description: WithdrawInput specifies a validator to withdraw from.

amount_gwei.description: Amount in Gwei (0 = full withdrawal). uint64 supports ~18 billion ETH (~150x total supply).

WithdrawTransactionInputs.description: WithdrawTransactionInputs echoes back the request parameters.

signers.description: Addresses that must sign this transaction (withdrawal address).

WithdrawTransactionItem.description: WithdrawTransactionItem contains input parameters and the unsigned transaction.

withdrawal_credentials_type.description:
Withdrawal credentials type.
Withdrawal credentials type: "0x01" (execution) or "0x02" (compounding, EIP-7251).

amount_gwei.description: Withdrawal amount in Gwei. uint64 supports ~18 billion ETH (~150x total supply).

is_full_withdrawal.description: Whether this was a full withdrawal (validator exited).

Withdrawal.description: Withdrawal represents a historical withdrawal event.

operators.description: Node operator identifiers involved in this operation (e.g., ["galaxy"], ["galaxy", "figment"]).

artifacts.description: Artifacts produced by this operation (available when completed).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the operation was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the operation was last updated.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the operation completed (success or failure).

operator_results.description: Per-operator execution results (populated for terminal states).

v1.Operation.description: Operation represents a staking operation and its lifecycle.

DeleteWebhookResponse.description: DeleteWebhookResponse is returned on successful deletion.

ListWebhooksResponse.description: ListWebhooksResponse returns all registered endpoints (without secrets).

url.description: The HTTPS URL to deliver webhook events to.

secret.description:
Shared secret used for HMAC-SHA256 request signing. Minimum 16 characters.
If omitted, the router generates a cryptographically random secret.
This value is write-only and will never be returned in subsequent responses.

events.description:
Event type filter. Accepted values:
  - "operation.completed": emitted when an operation reaches SUCCEEDED or PARTIAL_SUCCESS status.
  - "operation.failed": emitted when an operation reaches FAILED status.
An empty list means all event types are delivered.

RegisterWebhookRequest.description: RegisterWebhookRequest registers a new webhook endpoint.

signing_secret.description:
The HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for this endpoint.
Shown once on creation and never returned again.

RegisterWebhookResponse.description:
RegisterWebhookResponse returns the registered endpoint plus the signing secret.
The signing_secret is shown exactly once — store it on the client side.

url.description: The HTTPS URL that receives webhook events.

events.description:
Event type filter. Accepted values:
  - "operation.completed": emitted when an operation reaches SUCCEEDED or PARTIAL_SUCCESS status.
  - "operation.failed": emitted when an operation reaches FAILED status.
An empty list means all event types are delivered.

WebhookEndpoint.description:
WebhookEndpoint represents a registered webhook endpoint.
The secret is write-only and never returned in list/get responses.

Request to create and initialize a durable nonce account.

The nonce account is funded by funding_pubkey and initialized with nonce_authority_pubkey as authority.
Keep the account funded above the rent-exempt minimum (1_447_680 lamports) to avoid data loss.

Creates a new stake account with the specified amount split from the source.
The new account address is derived via CreateAccountWithSeed.

public.solana.v1.DurableNonceParams.description:
DurableNonceParams selects durable-nonce mode for a transaction request.
When set, the gateway fetches the current nonce value from nonce_account_pubkey on-chain and
embeds it as the transaction blockhash, with AdvanceNonceAccount prepended as the first instruction.
This removes the ~60-second blockhash expiry window, allowing offline/deferred signing.

public.solana.v1.GalaxySolanaParams.description: GalaxySolanaParams are Galaxy-specific parameters for Solana operator requests.

stake_accounts.description: Required. Solana stake account addresses to query rewards for. Maximum 100 entries.

operators.description:
Optional. Filter by node operator name (e.g., "figment", "galaxy").
Multiple operators may be specified.

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with end_date for daily-rollup mode.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with start_date for daily-rollup mode.

start_epoch.description:
Start epoch number. Use with end_epoch for per-epoch mode.
Note: 0 is treated as "not set".

end_epoch.description:
End epoch number. Use with start_epoch for per-epoch mode.
Note: 0 is treated as "not set".

page_size.description:
Maximum number of results to return per page.

page_size == 0 with an empty page_token is a sentinel meaning
"auto-pagination": SR will transparently follow NR's next_page_token until
all pages are consumed and return the complete merged result set with an
empty next_page_token. Clients MUST NOT interpret 0 as "return zero results".

For pass-through (manual) pagination, set page_size to the desired page
size and use the returned next_page_token to advance through pages. The
same page_size must be supplied on all subsequent requests for the same
pagination session.

next_cursor.description:
Opaque pagination token returned by a previous response.

Supplying a non-empty page_token activates pass-through pagination: SR makes
a single NR call for that page and returns the NR-provided next_page_token
wrapped in an SR envelope. Leave empty (together with page_size == 0) to
request auto-pagination.

SolanaStakeAccountStatus represents the on-chain delegation state of a stake account.

 - ACTIVATING: Delegation is warming up; stake will become active at the next epoch boundary.
 - ACTIVE: Delegation is active and earning rewards.
 - DEACTIVATING: Deactivation has been initiated; stake will become inactive at the next epoch boundary.
 - INACTIVE: Not delegated, or deactivation epoch has elapsed.

 - CONFIRMED: Transaction has been confirmed or finalized on-chain.
 - FAILED: Transaction was processed but failed (on-chain error).
 - NOT_FOUND: Signature is not known to the RPC node (never submitted or not yet indexed).

public.solana.v1.WithdrawNonceRequest.description:

Accepts any positive amount_lamports and transfers that amount to the recipient.
